opening.argument: The tutorial actively directs viewers to use account funds to purchase OneCoin, walking through a EUR 277.20 purchase of 62 coins and explaining how to place the order. The interface shows the submitted purchase as pending, making the token-purchase pathway concrete without establishing a completed transaction. Alongside those instructions, the speaker presents weekly earnings of €330 and accumulated bonuses of 1179.98 as benefits of participation. Together, the purchase instructions and displayed earnings establish a solicitation to buy tokens, with the account’s claimed benefits supplying the inducement.
